stats.note: sev5 removes all chroma; target retains 20% -> rejected

analysis.rationale: Single deterministic step preserved 20% chroma (target saturation_chroma_ratio=0.2032) matching saturate_weaken_HSV S-scale=0.2 (severity 4). Pixel-perfect reproduction on pair0 and all 4 support pairs (PSNR=inf, CI 10/10 each). No noise (peeled residual std=0.0, noise_prior sigma=0.0), no blur (gm_ratio=0.994, FFT anisotropy=0.00), no JPEG (block_boundary=1.0087, unique_G=256). mean_shift=10.1 is a side effect of HSV desaturation lifting RGB mean, not a brightness step.
